name: Building and Deploying AI in K-12 Schools
description: Evaluate a California district’s AI deployment through privacy intake, tested access and minimum data, a cautious tutor evaluation, funded safety response, subgroup model/scoring audits and usable individualized communications. Build a cumulative board dossier using synthetic materials, six module Decision Labs and a strategic capstone.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Building and Deploying AI in K-12 Schools

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 22 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
